mods.steamDescription:
DTMAPI 是玩家自制的多洛可小镇功能性 Mod 的运行前置，作为官方提供功能性mod接口前的中间态产品。
提供配置菜单、日志诊断、Manager 状态页、报告导出和功能性 Mod 运行支持。

订阅后请双击运行\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\2285550\3743016467\1_install_dtmapi.bat 安装 DTMAPI 前置。
如果双击运行1_install_dtmapi.bat出现黑色窗口但无反应，请尝试切换网络后再运行。

安装后双击运行同目录下3_check_dtmapi_status.bat即可检查状态，显示[OK]即可，[MISSING]请再运行1_install_dtmapi.bat尝试。
同目录下2_xxxx是卸载。
如果游戏闪退或打不开，请运行同目录下4_collect_dtmapi_logs.bat，并把桌面生成的DTMAPI-logs文件夹一起发给我。

点击主菜单左上角图标打开mod配置菜单。别忘记在官方mod界面启用模组。如果启用mod但DTMAPI菜单内没有加载出来，尝试重启游戏。
近期更新频率较高，如果您发现有mod使用不了或报错，请先尝试运行1_install_dtmapi.bat更新DTMAPI。
有问题请至少带着3_check截图、问题描述加steam好友/QQ好友3033654263联系。留言的一句话描述的问题我实在没法帮您判断。

安装前请务必先卸载旧版本SMAPI，双击运行\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\2285550\3726044511\2_uninstall_loader.bat。
安装前请务必先卸载旧版本SMAPI，两者文件夹不同，同时启用会冲突。
安装前请务必先卸载旧版本SMAPI，旧版本SMAPI已经不提供更新。

localizedDescription.english:
DTMAPI is a player-made runtime prerequisite for functional Doloc Town mods, used as an intermediate product before official functional mod APIs exist.
It provides the config menu, log diagnostics, Manager status pages, report export, and runtime support for functional mods.

After subscribing, double-click \Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\2285550\3743016467\1_install_dtmapi.bat to install the DTMAPI prerequisite.
If double-clicking 1_install_dtmapi.bat opens a black window but nothing happens, try switching networks and run it again.

After installation, double-click 3_check_dtmapi_status.bat in the same folder to check status. [OK] means ready; if it shows [MISSING], run 1_install_dtmapi.bat again.
2_xxxx in the same folder is the uninstaller.
If the game crashes or cannot open, run 4_collect_dtmapi_logs.bat in the same folder and send me the DTMAPI-logs folder created on your Desktop.

Click the icon in the upper-left corner of the main menu to open the mod configuration menu. Do not forget to enable mods in the official mod screen. If a mod is enabled but does not appear in the DTMAPI menu, try restarting the game.
Updates are frequent right now. If a mod stops working or reports errors, first try running 1_install_dtmapi.bat to update DTMAPI.
For help, please include at least a screenshot of 3_check, a description of the issue, and contact me by Steam friend request or QQ 3033654263. One-line comments are not enough for me to diagnose.

Before installing, make sure to uninstall the old SMAPI first by double-clicking \Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\2285550\3726044511\2_uninstall_loader.bat.
Before installing, make sure to uninstall the old SMAPI first; the two use different folders and will conflict if enabled together.
Before installing, make sure to uninstall the old SMAPI first; the old SMAPI no longer receives updates.

update 0616
Log files only keep the most recent ten game startup logs.

update 0617
Improved offline installation.

mods.steamDescription:
依赖 DTMAPI。
扩展官方箱子定位器的共享容器范围，让贴了定位器的箱子和储物架纸箱在不同建筑房间也能参与制作、研究等材料路径。

开发者手测夹具。
用于扫描普通、藤蔓、菌包、灌木等作物容器；乔木盆、草/采集类仅用于确认不支持边界，不执行收获。

依赖 DTMAPI。
存档内按 Y 打开调试控制台，提供兼容mod的物品给予、天气修改、传送（请尽量不要提前传送到未解锁地区，不排除会出现bug导致坏档，如果误点不要保存）、时间快进、时间倍速、移速修改、增加螺母金币、解锁科技、获得临时科技点、召唤满隐藏产物的动物、怪物召唤等测试用功能。怪物和动物批量召唤采用可见的部分成功语义：本批首次失败即停止，已经生成的实体会保留，结果会显示请求根数、成功根数和实际新增实体数。旧城守护者按 1 个主体加 2 个炮台识别，支持普通 1 组与右键 10 组。
